parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the source cluster where a database link is to be deleted.

>  You can call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~173433~~) operation to query PolarDB clusters.

parameters.name: DBLinkName
parameters.description: The name of the database link to be deleted.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb delete-db-link --db-cluster-id pc-00000000000000 --db-link-name dblink_test --region cn-hangzhou
